rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i8863 p. 3, Who cannot claim a credit, "5. The student has not been issued a TIN by the due date of his or her 2025 return (including extensions)"; p970 p. 11, "If an ATIN or ITIN is applied for on or before the due date of a 2025 return (including extensions) and the IRS issues an ATIN or ITIN as a result of the application, the IRS will consider the ATIN or ITIN as issued on or before the due date of the return". executable-triage-v2 (rerun of triage.py's triage() with the witness cap lifted, record in scratch `/tmp/adj-bklg-dep-f2441/triage/dependent.gpt.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 2,946 partial records from 40 bases; 9,011 comparisons): 8,744 of 9,011 agree; 233 candidate-refuses, 28 candidate-unknown, 4 project-refuses, 2 value; on completed returns: 4 candidate-unknown, 2 candidate-refuses, 1 value. Its American opportunity test requires dependent.edu_tin_issued where the project accepts a timely ITIN or ATIN application: classm.f8863.2 and classm.aqee.1 (and .deepseek variants) are completed returns where the project gives line 27 $4,000.00 and the candidate needs the answer (4 completed unknowns). The completed value (generated 445 dep_a, $1,471.34 against $0.00) is married no with joint_return yes, a record the interview cannot produce: dependent.married asks "married at the end of 2025 ..., or is a joint return being filed for 2025 that includes this person", so a No settles the joint return. Project stands.

Your unmarried qualifying child who isn't your dependent"; p501 p. 9, Temporary absences, "It must be reasonable to assume the absent person will return to the home after the temporary absence". executable-triage-v2 (rerun of triage.py's triage() with the witness cap lifted, record in scratch `/tmp/adj-bklg-dep-f2441/triage/dependent.gpt.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 2,946 partial records from 40 bases; 9,011 comparisons): 8,608 of 9,011 agree; 177 candidate-unknown, 109 project-refuses, 89 project-unknown, 15 value, 13 candidate-refuses; on completed returns: 67 candidate-unknown, 7 value, 2 candidate-refuses, 1 project-unknown. Inherits the reply's qualifying-child and claimed tests: 7 completed values (project yes, candidate no), all married no with joint_return yes, a record the interview cannot produce: dependent.married asks "married at the end of 2025 ..., or is a joint return being filed for 2025 that includes this person", so a No settles the joint return; 26 completed unknowns on joint_return and 24 on kidnapped. It also refuses the per-person absence where the project refuses only when head of household turns on it (household.hoh_absence, BUG-0267): 3 refusals off completed returns. Project stands.
